items.title: After 3 years of war, looking for calm in a murky Gaza swimming pool
items.description: Before Israel’s invasion of Gaza on Oct. 7, 2023, Ghada Abdulfattah loved to swim at her local pool. Now, she is tentatively returning to the water.

items.title: Israel, three years after October 7: A nation's traumas and blind spots
items.description: Amid an election campaign, Israel is commemorating the victims of the Hamas terrorist attack. Since the tragedy, the country has pursued an endless war, driven by a desire for revenge, without questioning the failures that led to the disaster.

items.title: What does a year-long ceasefire in Gaza look like?
items.description: Israel attacked Gaza nine days out of 10 during a so-called ceasefire.

items.title: How NATO Plans to Win: ‘Theory of Victory’ Against Russia to be Unveiled in Poland
items.description: NATO’s top commander in Europe will unveil a strategy for defeating a potential Russian attack on the alliance’s eastern flank. The plan draws on Ukraine’s war experience, emphasizing low-cost drones, AI targeting and rapid strikes on Russian command systems.

items.title: Israelis mourn on the anniversary of the Oct. 7 as Palestinians grapple with war it sparked
items.description: Israelis are gathering Wednesday to commemorate the Oct. 7, 2023, attack that killed 1,200 people, and sparked a devastating war in Gaza that Palestinians still grapple with.
